questions.question: What is the minimum conductor ampacity required for a 600V, 3-phase, 25 KVA capacitor bank?
solution_steps: Capacitor rated current = 25000 / (600 x 1.732) = 24.06 A.
Conductor ampacity must be at least 125% of rated current = 24.06 x 1.25 = 30.1 A.

questions.question: What is the maximum fuse size permitted for the capacitor in the above question (600V, 3-phase, 25 KVA)?
solution_steps: Capacitor rated current = 25000 / (600 x 1.732) = 24.06 A.
Overcurrent device may be up to 270% of rated current per Rule 26-210; 24.06 x 2.7 = 64.96 A, so 65 A.

questions.question: The impedance of a 225 KVA, 600-120/208, three-phase transformer is 2.5%. When replacing the overcurrent device on the secondary, what is the minimum short-circuit current rating required?

Maximum fault current = full-load current / impedance = 624.6 / 0.025 = 24,982 A.
